decision_logic.GO: Every essential gate is PASS on release-specific evidence. No gate relies only on a promise, public-paper aggregate, unvalidated ASR, or simulator substitution for an absent ChildLens measure.
decision_logic.REVISE: No fundamental STOP condition is established, but at least one essential gate is CONDITIONAL or UNRESOLVED and has a bounded, named correction that preserves the scientific aim and one-corpus boundary.
decision_logic.STOP: At least one essential gate FAILS in a way that cannot be repaired without prohibited data ancestry, corpus mixing, materially changing the lexical-grounding question, or violating the release terms/privacy boundary.
decision_logic.blocked: If a license or DUA action must be taken by the user before the evidence can be inspected or the predeclared pilot can run, do not assign a terminal scientific state; identify the exact user-only action and pause.

gates.pass_rule: Release-specific terms or certificate explicitly support research access, local read-only processing, restricted derived transcripts/annotations, and export of nonidentifying aggregates under required safeguards.
gates.fail_rule: Terms prohibit any required processing or derivative, or require a use incompatible with the scientific aim.
gates.evidence_minimum: Verbatim-free permission matrix with source path/version/date and unresolved clauses; no acceptance or share mutation.

gates.pass_rule: The accessible release can be pinned by Keeper library/share identity plus a canonical nonidentifying file manifest, and participant/session grouping needed for leakage control is available without exporting identifiers.
gates.fail_rule: No stable release identity or no defensible participant/session grouping can be obtained.
gates.evidence_minimum: Counts and byte totals by top-level class, metadata checksums where permitted, reconciliation against public-paper counts, and grouping-field audit.

gates.pass_rule: On a predeclared authorized pilot, at least 80% of sampled annotated-video duration is technically decodable and at least 70% of speech-bearing sampled windows have usable utterance boundaries after manual correction; coverage and uncertainty are reported.
gates.fail_rule: Audio is absent, systematically unusable, or cannot support utterance timing even with bounded correction.
gates.evidence_minimum: Container/codec audit plus content-blind selection and human timing validation; coarse speech-presence labels alone do not pass.

gates.pass_rule: Actual language is identified from release evidence or a permitted pilot; fixed ASR/diarization output is human-validated and correctable. On a stratified validation set of at least 300 utterances or 30 speech minutes, whichever comes first, non-child versus child/uncertain speaker-role macro-F1 is at least 0.80 and adult-directed lexical token error after correction is bounded. Raw ASR is never gold.
gates.fail_rule: Language-compatible transcription is unavailable or speaker role cannot be recovered adequately for non-child input.
gates.evidence_minimum: Model/version/provenance receipt, language-routing rule, blinded double annotation on at least 20% of validation items, uncertainty, and error taxonomy.

gates.pass_rule: Validated non-child speech contains recurring corpus-local lexical material sufficient to predeclare at least 8 noun/object and 6 verb/action candidate types, each supported across at least 3 participant groups and with a feasible train-only exposure threshold to be frozen before outcome training.
gates.fail_rule: Non-child speech is too sparse, lexical recurrence is too low, or candidate types are confined to one participant/session.
gates.evidence_minimum: Cell-suppressed distribution summaries only; no token strings unless terms explicitly permit a nonidentifying vocabulary export.

gates.pass_rule: At least 15% of validated non-child utterances in usable video windows have one or more annotatable visible object/action candidates, null and ambiguous cases are retained, and double-coded status agreement is Krippendorff alpha or equivalent at least 0.67 with a bounded adjudication path.
gates.fail_rule: Visible candidates are vanishingly rare or the frozen ontology cannot be applied reliably after bounded revision.
gates.evidence_minimum: Predeclared context window, status ontology, blinded double coding, cluster-aware interval, and no example frames/text in exported reports.

gates.pass_rule: A participant-disjoint primary split and session-disjoint sensitivity split can be constructed, with candidate noun/action types retaining train exposure and held-out evaluation support across at least 3 held-out participant groups; exact thresholds freeze before any learner outcome.
gates.fail_rule: Leakage-resistant splitting destroys lexical/action support or grouping cannot be enforced.
gates.evidence_minimum: No identifiers; report only cell-suppressed support counts and deterministic split algorithm/digest.

gates.pass_rule: The same ChildLens-derived vision/text inventory can later instantiate a strong-alignment ceiling and weak baseline using frozen alignment transformations, without inspecting cue effects or changing endpoints.
gates.fail_rule: The corpus cannot define both controls without unequal empirical exposure or outcome-driven alignment choices.
gates.evidence_minimum: Protocol-level construction proof only; no learner training in this audit.

gates.pass_rule: Terms allow required nonidentifying ChildLens video/audio aggregates; all absent IMU, touch, contact, proprioception, and motor variables are explicitly unavailable and only simulator-defined counterfactual modalities, with no claim of ChildLens measurement.
gates.fail_rule: Required aggregate calibration is prohibited or absent physical streams are represented as measured/calibrated from another corpus.
gates.evidence_minimum: Measurement-by-measurement source/availability table and ancestry policy.

gates.pass_rule: Selective acquisition fits the host with at least 30 GiB reserve, the annotation plan is bounded and staffable, and later paired bundles have a deterministic one-MPS or identical-CUDA/Slurm execution plan.
gates.fail_rule: The minimal prototype cannot fit plausible storage, annotation, or compute constraints.
gates.evidence_minimum: Low/base/high projections, cache deletion policy, worker caps, and paired-bundle merge controls.

privacy_rules.reportable: Only terms-permitted, nonidentifying, cell-suppressed aggregates, schemas, hashes, counts, and procedural evidence.
privacy_rules.small_cell_rule: Suppress or coarsen any participant-linked or lexical cell below 5; never use complementary cells to reconstruct a suppressed cell.
